descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S03 Existing pre-round notepad specs: the fullscreen editor and its points channel, typed text autosaves, a (mocked) dictation is saved as reviewed

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The Pre-Round tab has two boxes: the dictation (most of the screen) and Important Points (TC-12). (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 How it works 1; TFA-92590 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr; TFA-92590 in progress
  • T2 Tapping the Pre-Round notepad opens a fullscreen editor, as in Vikram's existing app, not a fixed small box. (TFA-92588 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U3 Dictated and typed input both save reliably and both produce a usable summary; Save Note reliably commits the note. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 3; TFA-92588 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U4 The stored dictation is identical on reopen: Save Note never rewrites, summarizes or renames the physician's text (issue #39), tested with unusual phrasing. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Tim's chromium fixtures: a Hospital patient with pre-round text and a points draft on file; a browser speech-recognition mock that emits one phrase

When Tap 'Open pre-round notes editor'; add and delete a point; type into the pre-round box and close the editor; separately dictate through the mock, stop, review, Save Note

Then The editor dialog covers the whole viewport and holds the notes box, the Important Points heading, Dictate, Dictate point and Save Note; points add/delete persist across a reload; typed text is stored without pressing Save Note; the dictated text is stored exactly as shown in the box

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions (editor bounding box equals the viewport; headings and controls visible; rounding.list preRoundNotes equals the text). Hospital, desktop viewport, a browser speech mock rather than the gpt-live server path, no unusual phrasing: Nursing Home is S02, phone widths S23, unusual phrasing S05, a real microphone S04, 'most of the screen' Q8. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S03

Existing pre-round notepad specs: the fullscreen editor and its points channel, typed text autosaves, a (mocked) dictation is saved as reviewed

Tickets: TFA-92588 Pre-Rounding Summary (ready for qa); TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress)

New local lane newspec-c: status blocked in newspec-c/results.json → blocked (blocked).

Detail:

Lane A on 43c38a4f (scripts/spec-matrix.mjs, Tim's tests by title from cases/e2e-titles.tsv regenerated for 43c38a4f; run under the local lock with the tripwire). 3 of 4 cells pass: chart.spec.ts 'entry opens a fullscreen editor with a separate manual-points channel' (AC 11), 'typed notes survive closing the editor' (AC 4), important-points.spec.ts 'Important Points is nested in the editor and add/delete persist' (U1's points half belongs to TFA-92590, in progress: recorded). The 4th cell, chart.spec.ts 'on-device dictation is reviewable and saved' (AC 3 dictation / AC 5), is blocked (local live-model guard): Tim's test presses Save Note without mocking the summary call, so its one Save Note reached ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes on the local stack's model (batch tripwire: 'model call parsing.parsePreRoundNotes +1'; the only model call any of this package's local runs made). Its assertion (the stored text equals the dictated text) held, but under the coordinator's rule it is not counted. The other two lane-A runs of chart.spec's summary-failure test press Save Note once, blocked by their own failFirst, and reach no model.

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright specs e2e/chart.spec.ts and e2e/important-points.spec.ts, chromium): they make and seed fresh @roundai.test accounts through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key, and the dictation half uses a browser speech mock; dev has no admin key and one shared account, so…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local matrix (lane A)] passed (matrix/TC-10.results.json)
